title: Qmes: Quantum Meta-Learning for Encoding Selection in Quantum Kernel Methods
summary: Selecting an effective encoding quantum circuit is a key challenge in quantum kernel methods because different feature maps can lead to different performance. Conventional methods require constructing and evaluating every circuit for each new dataset, making it computationally expensive. We present Qmes, an open-source Python package that automatically recommends circuits through meta-learning.
